The '''Morytania Spider Cave''' is a cave found north-east of [[Darkmeyer]].

The cave is divided into three sections; the main cavern, a task-only cavern and [[Araxxor]]'s cavern. The caves are full of [[araxyte]]s that are capable of inflicting [[venom]]. 

The main part of the cave contains a mix of both level 96 and 146 araxytes, along with five tunnels leading to other sections of the cave. The tunnel closest to the hive leads to the beginning sequence for the [[Amulet of rancour (s)]]. Three tunnels further down the cave lead to varying points in the task-only section, which itself has three chambers; one chamber to the north and south containing level 146 araxytes, and one in the middle containing level 96 araxytes. Another tunnel, not near the others, leads to Araxxor. The entire cave, apart from the north task-only cavern, is entirely [[Multicombat area|multicombat]].

The cave is also visited during [[A Night at the Theatre]] [[quest]] by the player when they are tasked to obtain [[strange spider eggs]]. A skeleton, belonging to one of [[Daer Krand]]'s unfortunate assistants, can be found and searched for a [[sticky note]] at the end of the cave during the quest.

==Transportation==
The quickest methods of reaching the [[cave (Morytania Spider Cave)|cave entrance]] are as follows:
* Teleporting directly to the cave via use of a [[spider cave teleport]]
* Teleporting to [[Hallowed Sepulchre]] using a [[hallowed crystal shard]], then exiting and using the [[Wall (Darkmeyer)|wall shortcut]] just south east. Requires 63 [[Agility]] and installing 2 [[long rope]]s.
* Teleporting via [[ectophial]] or [[fairy ring]] code {{fairycode|ALQ}}, then running south past the small bridge. Ectophial can be used for convenient banking at [[Port Phasmatys]] as well.
